title: موس با تکه‌های ماهی تن و مرغ | Voskes
heading: MOUSSE WITH FLAKES TUNA & CHICKEN
description: Voskes Mousse with tuna and chicken pieces is a tasty, grain-free treat specially developed to responsibly spoil your cat. Thanks to the presence of fish, rich in omega fatty acids, this snack supports healthy skin and a shiny coat. The addition of cranberries supports urinary tract health, while antioxidants contribute to a strong immune system. This way, your cat not only enjoys a delicious treat but also receives valuable support for its health.
